options.effort_note: No reasoning-effort flag; model choice carries the tradeoff.

--yolo.why: Kept: --approval-mode auto_edit approves edits and refuses every shell command when nobody attends, and allowing the few an implementer's gates need takes a policy file (policyPaths, or --policy) ao does not write, or --allowed-tools, which is deprecated; --yolo is deprecated too, for --approval-mode=yolo. Read on 2026-09-17 from github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli (docs/cli/cli-reference.md, docs/reference/policy-engine.md, packages/core/src/policy/policies/write.toml).
